readout_other: Resting-state fMRI sliding-window ROI-to-ROI connectivity among SCC, vmPFC and rACC; seed-to-brain connectivity; regional homogeneity (ReHo), amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (ALFF) and fractional-ALFF (fALFF); mood, anxiety and quality-of-life scales; structural MRI for safety
direction_notes: Active sonication produced a larger acute reduction in between-target (SCC-vmPFC-rACC) functional connectivity than sham approximately 1 hour post-treatment (Δr=-0.21, p<0.001), with return toward baseline by 24 hours; no clinical improvement in mood, anxiety or quality-of-life was observed.
safety_notes: No adverse events occurred, including sustained or clinically-significant worsening mood or anxiety, hypomanic symptoms, or structural MRI changes. The participant could not distinguish active from sham.

exposures.label: LIFU to subcallosal cingulate cortex (SCC), bilateral

device.model: clinical-prototype transmit/receive sparse hemispherical phased array (4096 transmit elements at 258 kHz, 256 receive elements at 129 kHz)

timing.protocol_description: Six treatment volumes were selected: bilateral SCC, vmPFC, and rostral anterior cingulate cortex (rACC), sonicated sequentially within a single session. Active and defocused sham sonications were performed 4 weeks apart under maintained blinding; only LIFU operators knew allocation.

source_quotes.n_subjects: We conducted a prospective randomized, blinded, active-versus-sham LIFU study in a 39- year-old man with TRD who had previously trialed multiple medications, psychotherapy, repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation, electroconvulsive therapy, and ketamine (additional information in Supplement Material).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Active and defocused sham sonications were performed 4 weeks apart under maintained blinding; only LIFU operators knew allocation.

flags.reason: The 0.5 MPa value is described as a 'target-wise mean' CT-simulation-estimated in-situ pressure across the treated volumes, not a separate value per target; applied identically to all three target exposures (SCC, vmPFC, rACC) because the paper does not break the pressure down by individual target.
PRF is stated as a range (0.45-0.50 Hz), recorded as a two-element list per the range convention.
This is a single-subject case study (n=1 patient).
Text states 'only LIFU operators knew allocation', implying both participant and other assessors were blinded; classified as double-blind.
